headline: Brazil Central Bank Holds Selic Rate at 13.75% Amid Rising Uncertainties
summary: Brazil's central bank unanimously voted to keep the Selic benchmark interest rate at 13.75% per year, interrupting a previous easing cycle and highlighting significantly increased economic uncertainties.
why: As Brazil's primary monetary policy tool, the Selic rate dictates domestic borrowing costs, influences fixed-income returns, and anchors inflation expectations in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic Rate
impacts.why: The central bank paused its rate cuts and held the benchmark rate at 13.75%.
